text: 我今天去书店买书。这本书二十块,那本书三十块,我想买这本。
textEnglish: Today I went to the bookstore to buy a book. This book is twenty yuan and that book is thirty yuan. I want to buy this one.
topic: Choosing a book at a bookstore

questions.explanation: The speaker says '这本书二十块', so this book costs twenty yuan. Thirty yuan is the price of the other book.

questions.promptEnglish: Which book does he want to buy?
questions.explanation: He says '我想买这本', meaning he wants this book, the twenty-yuan one, not the one that costs thirty.

issues.description: Question c2 uses 他 although the passage is narrated in the first person (我), so the pronoun does not match; 你 or 我 would be more natural.
